ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) features representing approximately 3-5% of the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark field across both lobes with high-intensity white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips and sparse punctate spots distributed across the central and lower surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to higher amplitude irregular peaks at the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex trailing edge trajectory with tips tapering to lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacles) at the extreme lateral margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple curvilinear high-intensity sequences (rake marks) on the upper right lobe and several shorter, unaligned linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial barnacle colonization at the fluke tips; significant linear scarring/rake marks on the dorsal-facing ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity transient noise pixels (water spray) primarily occluding the lower-central region of the fluke base.
